description: MiG-27ML allotted free to Rajkot Municipal Corporation, trucked from Jodhpur and installed at Kotecha Chowk on 15 Oct 2017 as a city beautification project (Indian Express 10 Oct 2017; Ahmedabad Mirror). Bharat Rakshak database identifies the Kotecha Circle aircraft as TS505; the serial is not confirmed by a photo read here. Coordinates approximate (chowk not geocoded).
